name: med-device-compliance-toolkit
description: MCP tool collection portal for medical device compliance: a single front-door expert that indexes and routes to ortho-mcp (8 tools) and MedTestLink, with install guidance and an extensible slot for future MCP assets.

displayDescription.en: A navigable portal aggregating MCP tools for medical device compliance — currently ortho-mcp (lab matching, quote, UDI, deadlines) and MedTestLink orchestration. Routes requests and guides installation of underlying assets.
displayDescription.zh: 医械合规 MCP 工具集合门户：聚合 ortho-mcp（机构匹配/报价/UDI/法规节点）与检械通编排能力，路由请求并引导安装底层资产，预留扩展位。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我是医疗器械企业的注册质量工程师，想看看你这工具箱里有哪些能力可以用
defaultInitPrompt.en: I'm a regulatory QA engineer at a medtech firm; show me what capabilities your toolkit has

quickPrompts.en: What MCP tools are in this toolkit and when should I use each?
quickPrompts.zh: 这个工具箱里有哪些 MCP 工具，分别什么时候用？

quickPrompts.en: Find testing labs for my spinal implant and compare quotes
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我的脊柱植入物找检测机构并比价

quickPrompts.en: Validate this UDI and tell me upcoming regulatory deadlines
quickPrompts.zh: 校验这个 UDI 并告诉我临近的法规节点
